description: This file defines a class for a plus-shaped data marker used in the Image_Graph PEAR PHP graph rendering utility. It extends the Image_Graph_Marker class and implements drawing logic for a plus-shaped marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Plus
classes.description: A class representing a plus-shaped marker for graph data points, extending the Image_Graph_Marker class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a plus-shaped marker on the canvas at specified (x, y) position, with optional data values.
